nl: config/local.env is tracked by Git but must not be. Remove it from version control without deleting the file, add the line config/local.env to .gitignore and commit both changes with the message 'Stop tracking config/local.env'.

setup.description: A Git repository that tracks config/local.env.
setup.bash:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
printf '%s' '# web-0
' > 'README.md'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'print('\''v1'\'')
' > 'src/app.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
mkdir -p 'src' && printf '%s' 'def helper():
    return 1
' > 'src/util.py'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
printf '%s' '*.pyc
' > '.gitignore'
mkdir -p 'config' && printf '%s' 'TOKEN=dev-0
' > 'config/local.env'
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000' git commit -qm 'Add local settings'
setup.pwsh:
git init -q -b main
git config user.name 'Bench User'
git config user.email bench@example.com
git config core.autocrlf false
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'README.md'), '# web-0
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/app.py'), 'print(''v1'')
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:00:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Initial commit'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'src' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'src/util.py'), 'def helper():
    return 1
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:01:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add helper module'
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD '.gitignore'), '*.pyc
')
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'config' | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PWD 'config/local.env'), 'TOKEN=dev-0
')
git add -A; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_DATE = '2026-10-01 08:02:00 +0000'; git commit -qm 'Add local settings'

oracle_program:
git.stage "." action: untrack paths: ["config/local.env"]
write ".gitignore" "config/local.env" mode: append ensure_newline: true
git.commit "." message: "Stop tracking config/local.env" paths: [".gitignore", "config/local.env"]
reference_bash:
git rm -q --cached -- 'config/local.env'
echo 'config/local.env' >> .gitignore
git add .gitignore
git commit -qm 'Stop tracking config/local.env'

negatives.script:
git rm -q -- 'config/local.env'
echo 'config/local.env' >> .gitignore
git add .gitignore
git commit -qm 'Stop tracking config/local.env'
